recognition.summary: Validated findings can receive Hall points even when ineligible for a monetary bounty.

reporting.summary: The security-reporting page publishes a direct encrypted-email route.

rewards.summary: Eligible reports may receive discretionary cash awards; Hall points are not themselves money.

limitations: The policy restricts investigation to locally running testnets and requires confidentiality. Eligibility wording is not fully consistent, so no award or acceptance is guaranteed.
rights: Original summary CC BY 4.0; linked sources and trademarks retain their own rights.
